name: Extreme Sound Muffler

mechanics.title: Muffling
mechanics.description: Open the muffler screen (inventory button or assignable key), choose a sound, optionally set its volume (mute to 90%) and preview it with the play button. Lists: all, muffled, recent, blocks, mods.

mechanics.title: Anchors
mechanics.description: Up to 10 anchors muffle selected sounds only within a configurable range of a marked position; anchors can be named and moved.

commands_and_keybinds: Key to open the muffler screen can be assigned in Controls (default not documented); the inventory button can be dragged with right mouse or disabled in config
getting_started: Click the muffler button in your inventory, then click the button next to the sound you want to silence.
editor_notes: Default keybind not in facts. Client only; installing on server does nothing.
summary: Client-side mod to mute or lower the volume of almost any sound, chosen from an in-game list. Includes ranged 'anchors' that muffle sounds only near a set position.
